newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans down in good volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans down in good volume.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were weaker in heavy trade midsession Monday at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with pressure from harvest supply and lower prices in Chicago weighing on bids, traders said.

The FAS elevator soybean price in Rosario lost $3 to $304. Buenos Aires spot maize was steady at $108 in good volume trade. Turnover is begin fed by good yields from the southern maize areas. Buenos Aires sunflower seed was steady at $230, in tight volume with little supply as sellers concentrate on other products. Cash wheat lost $2 in Buenos Aires to $176 in slow trade, with local millers almost alone in the market.
